name: single-stage-reflectron
description: Ideal single-stage reflectron at the first-order energy focus, where the total field-free path is four penetration depths. Analytic flight time 10.1805 us for m/z 500 at 4 keV: 2L/v of drift plus 2v/a of turnaround. Arrival time is flat to first order in energy, so sweeping the acceptance moves it by only the second-order term. The mirror depth and the cap potential are declared parameters, so this model can be swept and optimised as it stands.

turningDepth.description: How far into the mirror the potential reaches capPotential. The penetration depth of an ion at the full acceleration potential.

capPotential.description: Potential at the back of the mirror. Equal to the acceleration potential here, so the ion turns exactly at turningDepth; a supply drifting off that moves the turning point and the flight time with it.

acceleration.description: Acceleration potential the ion is launched at.

gradient.description: The mirror field. Derived, because it is a consequence of the two above rather than a knob of its own.
